text.content:
The nation Night City isn't part of.

Kind: National government
Leadership: President Rosalind Myers, former Militech CEO
Purpose: Reuniting America, by force if need be

Born of a new constitution after the Time of the Red, the NUSA has had presidents from the corporate world since its first, David Whindam. Rosalind Myers launched the Unification War against the Free States in 2069; it ended in 2070 at Night City's edge, with the Arvin Accord.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.16
